extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by sex. One duplicate row was removed. The label 'FEMALE' was normalized to 'female'. The 'body_mass_g' column was converted from text to numeric. Three extreme body mass values (over 3.5 million grams) were set to missing as likely data entry errors. One negative flipper length was also set to missing. The average body mass is 3788.19 grams for female penguins and 4492.00 grams for male penguins.
